source_caption:
Some things are only beautiful because they don’t last.

If everything stayed forever, it would lose its meaning. Maybe that’s the point we’re not meant to hold on forever, we’re meant to feel it while it’s here.We often spend our lives trying to make moments last forever, wishing the best parts of our story would never end. But the real beauty of a sunset and of life itself comes from the fact that it is finite. Things aren't beautiful despite the fact that they end; they are beautiful because they end. If the sun stayed in the sky forever, we’d eventually stop looking up. It’s the fragility of a moment that gives it all the meaning. 

I watched 12 Monkeys a while back, and honestly… it still hasn’t left my mind. It’s one of the most underrated sci-fi shows out there. People often compare it to Dark, but it’s a completely different experience. The way it handles time, consequences, casuality, paradoxes and closure is just… so satisfying. It starts off simple, but slowly builds into something much bigger and by the end, everything just fits perfectly. Definitely one of the best time travel narratives I’ve seen.
